title: Palestinian boy shot during Israeli raid on UNRWA centre
english: Israeli forces recently conducted a raid on a UNRWA training facility located in occupied East Jerusalem. During the operation, which was overseen by government minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, at least five Palestinians were shot and wounded. Video evidence has captured the specific moment a young Palestinian boy was struck by gunfire during the incident.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በተያዘው ምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም በሚገኝ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የስልጠና ማዕከል ላይ ወረራ ፈጽመዋል። ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪርን ጨምሮ በተመራው በዚህ ዘመቻ ወቅት ቢያንስ አምስት ፍልስጤማውያን በጥይት ተመትተው ቆስለዋል። በወረራው ወቅት አንድ ወጣት ፍልስጤማዊ ልጅ በጥይት ሲመታ የሚያሳይ የቪዲዮ ማስረጃ ተገኝቷል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el magaalaa Yerusaalem bahaa keessatti bakka leenjii kan dhaabbata UNRWA irratti duula gaggeessaniiru. Duula ministira Itamar Ben-Gvir hoogganame kanaan, namoonni biyyoolessummaan isaanii Palastayinii ta'e shan madaa'aniiru. Viidiyoon argame tokko akka agarsiisutti, yeroo duulichaatti mucaan dargaggeessi tokko rasaasaan rukutamee jira.

title: The RSF’s defeat will not end Sudan’s war but merely fragment it
english: Although the Sudanese army has recently achieved significant territorial gains against the Rapid Support Forces, experts warn this does not signal the end of the conflict. The military relies on a fragile coalition of various armed factions that may become difficult to control or satisfy once a common enemy is removed. Consequently, even a total defeat of the paramilitary group could lead to a fragmented landscape of smaller, ongoing regional conflicts.
amharic: የሱዳን ጦር በፈጣን ድጋፍ ሰጪ ኃይሎች (RSF) ላይ በቅርቡ ትልቅ ድል ቢቀዳጅም፣ ይህ የጦርነቱ ፍጻሜ ሊሆን እንደማይችል ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ። ጦርነቱ የተመሰረተው የጋራ ጠላት ከተወገደ በኋላ ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ በሚሆኑ የተለያዩ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ጥምረት ላይ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት የፓራሚሊታሪ ቡድኑ ቢሸነፍ እንኳን፣ ጦርነቱ ወደ ተለያዩ ትናንሽ እና የተበታተኑ ግጭቶች ሊሸጋገር ይችላል።
oromo: Waraanni Sudaan humnoota Rapid Support Forces (RSF) irratti injifannoo argatus, kun xumura waraana biyyattii ta'uu isaa ogeeyyoonni ni shakku. Mootummaan kan injifannoo kana argate garee hidhattoota adda addaa waliin tahuudhaan waan ta'eef, diinni ijoo yoo bade gareewwan kun walitti bu'uu malu. Kanaafuu, humnoonni RSF guutummaatti kufanis, waraanni sun gara garee xixiqqoo fi walitti bu'iinsa naannawaa adda addaatti kan faffaca'u ta'a.

title: Man United’s Fernandes, City’s Shaw named PFA Players of the Year
english: Manchester United's Bruno Fernandes has been named the PFA Men's Player of the Year after a record-breaking season of assists. Manchester City's Khadija Shaw received the Women's Player of the Year award following her impressive goal-scoring performance that helped her team win the league title. Additionally, City's Nico O'Reilly was honored as the Men's Young Player of the Year for his significant contributions to the club's trophy-winning season.
amharic: የማንቸስተር ዩናይትዱ ብሩኖ ፈርናንዴዝ በአስደናቂ የግብ ማመቻቸት ብቃቱ የዓመቱ ምርጥ የፒኤፍኤ ወንድ ተጫዋች ተብሎ ተመርጧል። የማንቸስተር ሲቲዋ ካዲጃ ሾው ቡድኗ የሊግ ዋንጫን እንዲያነሳ ባደረገችው ከፍተኛ የግብ ብቃት የዓመቱ ምርጥ የሴት ተጫዋች ሽልማትን ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ አግኝታለች። በተመሳሳይ፣ የሲቲው ኒኮ ኦሬሊ ለክለቡ ዋንጫዎች ማሳካት ባበረከተው አስተዋጽኦ የዓመቱ ምርጥ ወጣት ተጫዋች ተብሎ ተሸልሟል።
oromo: Taphataan Manchester United Bruno Fernandes rikoordii gargaarsa goolii uumuun erga galmeessee booda taphataa dhiiraa bara kanaa PFA ta'ee filatameera. Khadija Shaw kan Manchester City immoo taphataa dubartoota bara kanaa ta'uun badhaafamteetti; kunis gumaacha isheen goolii baay'ee galchuun gareen ishee shaampiyoonaa ta'uuf taasisteef kan kennameedha. Kana malees, Nico O'Reilly kan Manchester City taphataa dargaggeessa bara kanaa ta'uun badhaafameera.

title: Trump threatens Iran’s partners: How do secondary sanctions work?
english: The United States has launched a new campaign called 'Operation Economic Outcast' to further isolate Iran by targeting its global trade partners. Through the use of secondary sanctions, the U.S. is pressuring international entities to stop doing business with Tehran or face financial penalties themselves. This aggressive strategy aims to cut off Iran's revenue sources, including oil, while impacting global energy markets and supply chains.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግሥት ኢራንን በኢኮኖሚ ለመነጠል እና የንግድ አጋሮቿን ለመቅጣት 'ኦፕሬሽን ኢኮኖሚክ አውትካስት' የተሰኘ አዲስ እርምጃ ይፋ አድርጓል። በዚህ ስልት መሰረት፣ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት ያላቸው ዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች በኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጠቁ አሜሪካ አስጠንቅቃለች። ይህ አካሄድ የኢራንን የነዳጅ እና ሌሎች የገቢ ምንጮችን በማቋረጥ፣ በዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ እና አቅርቦት ሰንሰለት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እንደሚፈጥር ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyya Iraan gaffii diinagdee keessa galchuuf fi hiriyoota ishee daldalaa addunyaa irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf 'Operation Economic Outcast' kan jedhamu eegaleera. Ameerikaan dhaabbata ykn biyya kamiyyuu kan Iraan waliin daldalu irratti adabbii diinagdee akka fudhattu akeekkachiisteetti. Karoorri kun maddoota galii Iraan, keessattuu boba'aa addaan kutuun, dhiibbaa guddaa gabaa fi dhiyeessii boba'aa addunyaa irratti fiduu danda'a.

title: Serena Williams, Carlos Alcaraz fall in US Open mixed doubles quarterfinal
english: Tennis legends Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz were eliminated from the US Open mixed doubles tournament during the quarterfinal round. After winning their opening match together, the pair was defeated in straight sets by Flavio Cobolli and Belinda Bencic. The Italian-Swiss duo will now advance to face Elina Svitolina and Gael Monfils in the semifinals.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከቦች ሴሬና ዊሊያምስ እና ካርሎስ አልካራዝ በዩኤስ ኦፕን ድብልቅ ጥንድ ውድድር ከሩብ ፍጻሜው ተሰናብተዋል። ሁለቱ ተጫዋቾች የመጀመሪያ ጨዋታቸውን በአሸናፊነት ቢጀምሩም፣ በሩብ ፍጻሜው በፍላቪዮ ኮቦሊ እና በቤሊንዳ ቤንቺች ተሸንፈዋል። አሸናፊዎቹ ጥንዶች በግማሽ ፍጻሜው ከኤሊና ስቪቶሊና እና ከጋኤል ሞንፊልስ ጋር ይገጥማሉ።
oromo: Taphattoonni tenisii beekamoon Serena Williams fi Carlos Alcaraz dorgommii US Open gita jiddu galeessaatiin (mixed doubles) sadarkaa qurter fayinaal irraa hafan. Gareen kun tapha isaanii jalqabaa erga injifatanii booda, sadarkaa qurter fayinaal irratti Flavio Cobolli fi Belinda Bencic dura injifatamaniiru. Gareen injifate kunis sadarkaa semifaayinaaliitti Elina Svitolina fi Gael Monfils waliin wal morkatu.

title: How Turkey should respond to Israel's escalation in Syria
english: Israel recently conducted an airstrike on an inactive Syrian airbase located near the Turkish border, which Israeli officials described as a warning against Turkish military expansion. International observers and US officials have criticized the move as a reckless and unnecessary escalation that threatens regional stability. Analysts suggest the attack may be a strategic political maneuver by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to boost his support ahead of upcoming elections by creating an external threat.
amharic: እስራኤል በቅርቡ በቱርክ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ጥቅም ላይ በማይውል የሶሪያ አየር ማረፊያ ላይ የአየር ጥቃት የፈጸመች ሲሆን፣ የቱርክ ወታደራዊ መስፋፋትን ለመከላከል የተወሰደ እርምጃ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች። ዓለም አቀፍ ታዛቢዎች እና የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ይህን ድርጊት የክልሉን ሰላም አደጋ ላይ የሚጥል አላስፈላጊ እና አደገኛ ተግባር ሲሉ አውግዘውታል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ጥቃቱ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የፖለቲካ ትርፍ ለማግኘት እና በመጪው ምርጫ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት የፈጠሩት ስልት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ይገመታል።
oromo: Isiraa'el dhiyeenya kana buufata xiyyaaraa Sooriyaa kan daangaa Turkii biratti argamu fi tajaajila irra hin oolle irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwatteetti; mootummaan Isiraa'el qindoomina waraanaa Turkii ittisuuf kan fudhatame ta'uu ibseera. Hawaasni idil-addunyaa fi hoggantoonni Ameerikaa tarkaanfichi tasgabbii naannichaa kan booressu fi haala barbaachisaa hin taaneen kan guddifame ta'uu isaa balaaleeffataniiru. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun Ministirri Muummee Benyaamiin Netanyaanhuu filannoo dhufuuf qophii ta'an irratti sagalee argachuuf jecha haala nageenyaa sobaan uumuuf kan yaalan ta'uu mala.

title: ‘My land is forbidden to me’: Israel’s settlement push encircles Jenin
english: Israeli settlement expansion is rapidly increasing around Jenin in the occupied West Bank, forcing Palestinian farmers off their ancestral land. Local residents report being detained or attacked by settlers and soldiers for simply attempting to access their own properties. Authorities are reviving former settlement sites and seizing additional territory to establish new infrastructure, effectively cutting off the city and tightening control over Palestinian movement.
amharic: በተያዘው የምዕራብ ባንክ ጀኒን አካባቢ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ መስፋፋት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ፍልስጤማውያን አርሶ አደሮችን ከቀዬአቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ እያደረገ ነው። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች የራሳቸውን መሬት ለመጠቀም ሲሞክሩ በሰፋሪዎች እና በወታደሮች ጥቃት እየደረሰባቸውና እየታሰሩ መሆናቸውን ይገልጻሉ። ባለስልጣናት የቀድሞ ሰፈራዎችን እንደገና በማቋቋም እና አዳዲስ መሠረተ ልማቶችን በመገንባት ከተማዋን ከሌሎች አካባቢዎች የመገደል እና የፍልስጤማውያንን እንቅስቃሴ የመቆጣጠር ስራ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Baballinni manneen jireenyaa Israa'el naannoo Jenin kan Qilleensaa Lixaa keessatti ariifatee itti fufaa jiraachuun isaa, qonnaan bulaa Palastayinii lafa isaanii irraa ari'aa jira. Jiraattonni naannichaa lafa isaanii kan isaanii ta'e keessatti yemmuu hojjetanitti, qonnaan bulaa fi loltoonni Israa'el itti bahanii reebichaa fi hidhaa raawwachaa jiru. Mootummaan Israa'el manneen jireenyaa dur turan haaromsuu fi bu'uraalee misoomaa haaraa ijaaruun, magaalattii ganda biraa irraa gargar kutuu fi sochii namoota Palastayinii to'annoo jala oolchuu barbaada.

title: Report: Iranian attacks caused billions in 'unprecedented damage' to US intelligence sites in the Middle East
english: A recent report indicates that Iranian drone and missile strikes have inflicted severe and historic damage on various American intelligence facilities in the Middle East. These attacks targeted critical surveillance equipment and infrastructure belonging to the CIA and other agencies. Officials estimate that the cost to replace and repair these assets will reach billions of dollars, marking an unprecedented level of destruction for US intelligence operations in the area.
amharic: በቅርቡ የወጣ ዘገባ እንደሚያመለክተው፣ ኢራን ያደረሰችው የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ የስለላ ተቋማት ላይ ከፍተኛ እና ታሪካዊ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ጥቃቶቹ የሲአይኤ እና ሌሎች የስለላ ኤጀንሲዎችን ወሳኝ የክትትል መሣሪያዎች እና መሰረተ ልማቶች ኢላማ አድርገዋል። የጉዳቱን መጠን ለመጠገን እና መሣሪያዎችን ለመተካት በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ዶላሮች እንደሚያስፈልግ የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለአሜሪካ የስለላ ኦፕሬሽኖች ያልተለመደ የጉዳት መጠን ነው።
oromo: Gabaasni dhiheenya bahe tokko akka ibsutti, haleellaan droonii fi misaa'elaa Iraan raawwatte buufataalee basaastotaa Ameerikaa kan Baha Giddugaleessaatti argaman irratti miidhaa guddaa fi seenaa keessatti mul'atee hin beekne geessiseera. Haleellaan kun meeshaalee to'annoo fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa kan CIA fi dhaabbilee basaastotaa biroo irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. Miidhaa kana suphuuf fi meeshaalee bakka buusuuf baasiin isaa biliyoonaan kan lakkaa'amu ta'uun ibsameera; kunis hojii basaastotaa Ameerikaa kan naannichatti ta'e keessatti miidhaa sadarkaa ol'aanaa dha.

title: US Treasury Secretary and Bahraini finance minister discuss Iran sanctions
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent spoke with Bahrain's Finance Minister to coordinate efforts on maintaining financial pressure against Iran. They discussed preventing Iran from disrupting global trade or using regional maritime routes as political leverage. Both officials agreed to continue working together with regional partners to stop illegal financial activities and ensure economic security.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የግምጃ ቤት ፀሐፊ ስኮት ቤሰንት ከባህሬን የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ጋር በኢራን ላይ እየተደረገ ያለውን የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ በተመለከተ ውይይት አድርገዋል። በውይይታቸውም ኢራን ዓለም አቀፍ ንግድን እንዳትረብሽ እና የሆርሙዝን የባህር በር ለፖለቲካ ማስፈራሪያ እንዳትጠቀምባት አፅንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች ሕገ-ወጥ የገንዘብ እንቅስቃሴዎችን ለመግታት እና የጋራ የኢኮኖሚ ደህንነትን ለማጠናከር በጋራ እንደሚሰሩ ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa US Iskooti Besentiifi ministirri maallaqa Baahireen dhimma uggura diinagdee Iran irratti mari'ataniiru. Marii isaaniin, Iran daldala addunyaa akka hin gufachiifneefi daandii galaana Hormuz akka meeshaa dhiibbaa siyaasaatti akka hin fayyadamne irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Gareewwan lameenuu sochii maallaqa seeraan alaa ittisuufi nageenya diinagdee eeguuf gargaarsa waliinii cimsuuf walii galaniiru.

title: Morning update
english: President Trump has linked a nuclear agreement with Saudi Arabia to the kingdom's recognition of Israel, while facing accusations from Senator Van Hollen of personal profiteering. Tensions have also escalated as Israel expelled Dutch officials over settlement trade policies and continued military operations in Lebanon and Syria. Meanwhile, Yemeni forces reported successfully repelling a Houthi attack in the Taiz province.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከሳውዲ አረቢያ ጋር የሚደረገውን የኒውክሌር ስምምነት አገሪቷ እስራኤልን እውቅና ከመስጠት ጋር አያይዘውታል፤ በተመሳሳይ ጊዜም ሴናተር ቫን ሆለን ፕሬዝዳንቱ ከስልጣናቸው ተጠቃሚ መሆናቸውን ከሰዋል። እስራኤል በአይሁድ ሰፈራ ምርቶች ላይ በጣለችው እገዳ ምክንያት የደች ዲፕሎማቶችን በማባረር በሊባኖስና በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዋን ቀጥላለች። በሌላ በኩል፣ የየመን መንግስት ሃይሎች በታኢዝ ግዛት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተሰነዘረ ጥቃት ማክሸፋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Tiraamp waliigaltee niukleerii Sa'udii Arabiyaa wajjin jiru mootummaan sun Israa'elii beekkamtii kennuu isaa wajjin wal qabsiisaniiru, gama biraanis seenaatar Vaan Hoolen aangoo fayyadamee bu'aa dhuunfaa argachuu isaanitti himataniiru. Israa'el daldala buufataalee seeraan alaa irratti murtoo biyyi Neezerlaand dabarsiteen wal qabatee jila Neezerlaand ari'uun, Libaanoosii fi Sooriyaa keessatti duula waraanaa ishee itti fufteetti. Gama biraan, waraanni mootummaa Yaman naannoo Ta'izitti haleellaa garee Huutii of irraa ittisuu isaa beeksiseera.

title: Top official says Iran, Oman have agreed new temporary route in Hormuz
english: Iran and Oman have reached a tentative agreement to establish a temporary shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, which will pass partly through Iranian territorial waters. Despite this development, Iranian officials clarified that the waterway will remain closed to normal traffic until the United States adheres to its obligations under a previous peace agreement. Ongoing diplomatic and technical discussions are currently focused on managing the strait and addressing security concerns like mine clearing.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር በኩል በከፊል በኢራን ግዛት ውስጥ የሚያልፍ ጊዜያዊ የመርከብ መስመር ለመዘርጋት ተስማምተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት አሜሪካ ሰኔ ወር ላይ የተፈረመውን የሰላም ስምምነት ግዴታዋን እስካልተወጣች ድረስ የባህር በሩ ለተለመደው የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ክፍት እንደማይሆን አስታውቀዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት የባህር መንገዱን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ እና ፈንጂዎችን የማጽዳት ስራዎችን ለማስተባበር በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaan karaa markabni itti darbu kan yeroo gabaabaaf tajaajilu kan garri tokko bishaan biyya Iraan keessa darbu irratti waliigalteerra gahan. Ta'us, hoggantoonni Iraan hanga Ameerikaan waliigaltee nagaa ji'a Waxabajjii darbe mallatteeffame irratti dirqama ishee hin ba'annetti karaa kana gadi lakkisuuf akka hin qophoofne ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni lamaan kun dhimma nageenyaa fi qulqulleessa maayinii (mine) dabalatee, to'annoo daandii galaana kanaa irratti marii isaanii itti fufanii jiru.

title: Iran bets economic pain will pressure Trump in game of ‘chicken’
english: Iran is currently engaged in a high-stakes standoff with the United States, hoping that economic instability caused by ongoing conflicts will force President Trump to concede. By leveraging global market concerns and the potential political pressure on Republicans ahead of midterm elections, Tehran believes it can gain the upper hand. Analysts characterize this strategy as a dangerous game of 'chicken' where the regime bets that Washington will blink first to avoid further financial fallout.
amharic: ኢራን አሁን ከአሜሪካ ጋር ከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ የምትገኝ ሲሆን፣ በጦርነቱ ሳቢያ የሚፈጠረው የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕን ወደ ድርድር እንደሚያስገደዳቸው ታምናለች። የቴህራን ስትራቴጂ በአለም አቀፍ ገበያ ላይ የሚፈጠረውን ጫና እና በሪፐብሊካኖች ላይ የሚያርፈውን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ በመጠቀም አሜሪካን ወደ ኋላ እንድትል ማግባባት ነው። ተንታኞች ይህንን አካሄድ የሁለቱ ሀገራት ከፍተኛ የጥንቃቄ እና የፉክክር ጨዋታ አድርገው ይገልጹታል።
oromo: Iraan amma biyya Ameerikaa waliin walitti bu'iinsa cimaa keessa jirti; kunis gabaa addunyaa irratti miidhaa diinagdee uumamuun Pireezidaant Traamp akka harka kennan abdatti. Teheran dhiibbaa diinagdee kanaa fi yaaddoo siyaasaa filannoo giddu-galeessaa duratti Rippabilikoota irratti jiru fayyadamtee, Ameerikaan akka of duuba deebitu gochuuf yaaltii. Qaamoleen xiinxala siyaasaa adeemsa kana akka tapha 'chicken' jedhamu kan gita hin qabneefi hatattamaa ta'etti ilaalatu.

title: Fireworks factory goes up in smoke in Mexico
english: A fireworks manufacturing facility in Tultepec, Mexico, was completely destroyed following a pair of powerful explosions. The incident triggered a massive display of flames and sparks, leaving the building in ruins. Fortunately, authorities confirmed that there were no casualties reported from the blast.
amharic: በሜክሲኮ ቱልቴፔክ ከተማ በሚገኝ የርችት ማምረቻ ፋብሪካ ላይ ሁለት ተከታታይ ፍንዳታዎች ደርሰዋል። ፍንዳታው ፋብሪካውን ሙሉ በሙሉ ወደ መሬት ያወረደው ቢሆንም፣ በሰው ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት አለመኖሩን ባለሥልጣናት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Tultepeek, Meeksiikoo keessatti warshaan gubattoota bifa ibiddaatiin fayyadamnu (fireworks) oomishu tokko erga dhohee booda guutummaatti barbadaa'eera. Dhoohaan kun suuta jedhee kan dhabame ta'us, balaa lubbuun darbe ykn miidhaan qaamaa namoota irra ga'e akka hin jirre ibsameera.

title: Massive natural gas leak in Wisconsin puts community on alert
english: A serious natural gas leak occurred in Saxon, Wisconsin, after a vehicle collided with a pipeline. Local authorities ordered residents to evacuate and implemented a no-fly zone to ensure public safety. Power was also temporarily shut off in the area to minimize the risk of a major explosion.

oromo: Wiskoonsin keessatti konkolaataan gurguddaan iyyuu yeroo gaazii uumamaa bututu, gaazii guddaan akka gadhiifamu ta'eera. title: Russia’s ‘Amazon’ Wildberries comes under Ukraine attack again
english: Ukraine has launched another drone strike targeting Wildberries, Russia's largest online retailer. This latest attack hit a logistics center in the Tambov region, marking the twentieth such facility targeted by Ukrainian forces. The ongoing strikes aim to disrupt the infrastructure of this major commercial business.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ትልቁ የኦንላይን መገበያያ ድርጅት በሆነው ዋይልድቤሪስ ላይ ዳግም የድሮን ጥቃት አድርሳለች። ይህ የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥቃት በታምቦቭ ክልል በሚገኝ የሎጂስቲክስ ማዕከል ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ በድምሩ ዩክሬን የድርጅቱን 20 መጋዘኖች ማጥቃቷ ታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የኩባንያውን የስራ እንቅስቃሴ ለማስተጓጎል የታለሙ ናቸው።
oromo: Yukreenin dhaabbata gurgurtaa intarneetii kan Raashiyaa isa guddaa ta'e 'Wildberries' irratti lammata miidhaa diroonii raawwatteetti. Haleellaan kun kan qajeelfame naannoo Taamboovitti kan argamu bakka meeshaalee itti kuufatan irratti yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti giddu-galeeyyii 20 dhaabbatichaa haleelamaniiru. Haleellaan kun hojii fi bu'uura misooma dhaabbatichaa jeeqee dhaabuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Five commodity vessels transited Hormuz Strait on Tuesday
english: On Tuesday, only five cargo ships passed through the Strait of Hormuz, which is significantly lower than the usual daily average. These vessels included tankers transporting liquefied petroleum gas and bitumen, along with some empty ships. Experts noted that these figures might be incomplete because some vessels choose to disable their tracking devices while traveling.
amharic: ባለፈው ማክሰኞ አምስት የጭነት መርከቦች ብቻ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ማለፋቸውን የመርከብ እንቅስቃሴ መረጃዎች ያሳያሉ። ይህ ቁጥር በየቀኑ ከሚመዘገበው አማካይ መጠን በጣም ያነሰ ነው። በመርከቦቹ ውስጥ ፈሳሽ የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ፣ ቢቱመን እና ባዶ ታንከሮች የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ መርከቦች መከታተያ መሳሪያቸውን በማጥፋታቸው ትክክለኛው ቁጥር ሊቀየር እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxataa darbe markaboonni fe'umsaa shan qofa gara karaan Hormuz dabraan, kunis lakkoofsa guyyaa guyyaan dabraa ture irra baay'ee gad aana. Markaboonni kunneen gaazii uumamaa fi biitumen fe'aa kan turan yoo ta'u, warri kaan immoo markaboota duwwaa turan. Markaboonni tokko tokko meeshaa iddoo itti argaman beeksisu waan dhaabsisaniif, lakkoofsi kun gara fuulduraatti jijjiiramuu akka danda'u ibsameera.

title: Qatar slams Israeli defence minister's entry into Syrian territory
english: Qatar has officially condemned Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz for entering Syrian territory, labeling the action a violation of international borders and Syrian sovereignty. Katz visited the Mount Hermon region near the Syria-Lebanon border and stated that Israeli forces would stay as long as there are militant threats. This incident has drawn sharp criticism for undermining the territorial integrity of Syria.
amharic: የኳታር መንግስት የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ ወደ ሶሪያ ግዛት መግባታቸውን አውግዞታል፤ ድርጊቱንም ዓለም አቀፍ ድንበርን የጣሰ እና የሶሪያን ሉዓላዊነት የጋፋ ነው ብሏል። ሚኒስትሩ በሶሪያ እና በሊባኖስ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሄርሞን ተራራ አካባቢ በመገኘት፣ በክልሉ ያለውን የደህንነት ስጋት እስካልተወገደ ድረስ ኃይሎቻቸው በዚያ እንደሚቆዩ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የሶሪያን የግዛት አንድነት የሚፃረር በመሆኑ በኳታር በኩል ከፍተኛ ትችት ደርሶበታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Qatar ministeera ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz gara biyya Sooriyaatti seenuu isaanii cimsee balaaleffateera. Tarkaanfiin kun daangaa idil-addunyaa cabsuu fi kabajamuu dhabuu qulqulleeffannaa biyya Sooriyaa akka ta'e ibseera. Ministeerichi daangaa Sooriyaa fi Libaanoos irratti kan argamu Gaara Hermon daawwatee, humnoonni Israa'el hanga aanga'oota amantii irraa soda jiruutti iddoo sanatti akka turan dubbateera. Tarkaanfiin kun walaba ta'uu Sooriyaa waan miidhuuf biyyattiin mormii cimaa dhiyeessiteetti.

title: Ben Gvir celebrates Israeli raid on West Bank Unrwa office
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir publicly celebrated a recent military raid on UNRWA vocational centers located in the occupied West Bank. During the operation, forces targeted facilities in Qalandiya and Kufr Aqab that provide essential services to thousands of Palestinian refugees. Ben Gvir recorded himself in the agency's office, declaring that he intends to end the organization's presence in the region under his leadership.
amharic: የእስራኤል ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ በሚገኙ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ድርጅት (UNRWA) ማዕከላት ላይ የተፈጸመውን ወረራ በይፋ አሞካሹ። ወታደሮቹ በቃላንዲያ እና በኩፍር አቃብ የሚገኙ የሙያ ማሰልጠኛ ተቋማትን በመውረር በሺዎች ለሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች ሲሰጡ የነበሩ አገልግሎቶችን አቋርጠዋል። ቤን ግቪር በድርጅቱ ቢሮ ውስጥ ሆነው ድርጅቱ በክልሉ ያለው እንቅስቃሴ እንዲቆም ለማድረግ ቁርጠኛ እንደሆኑ በቪዲዮ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Ministirri nageenya biyyoolessaa Israa'el Itaamaar Ben Gviir, lafa weeraramee jiru West Bank keessatti dhaabbata gargaarsa baqattootaa UNRWA irratti duula waraanaa gaggeeffame gammachuudhaan fudhateera. Duula kanaanis buufataalee barnoota ogummaa Qalandiyaa fi Kufr Aqab keessatti argaman kan baqattoota kuma kudha ja'a tajaajilaa turan irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatameera. Ben Gviir ofii isaa waajjira dhaabbatichaa keessatti suuraa of kaasuudhaan, hojiin dhaabbatichaa naannichaa akka dhaabatu gochuuf murteeffachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Israeli explosions, shelling and strikes reported across south Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces have launched a series of attacks across southern Lebanon, including airstrikes, tank shelling, and controlled explosions. The strikes targeted multiple locations, such as Srebbine, Mansouri, al-Qantara, and Haddatha. These military actions occurred throughout the night and into Wednesday morning, increasing tensions in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በአየር ጥቃት፣ በታንክ ተኩስ እና በተለያዩ ፍንዳታዎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ጥቃቶቹ እንደ ስሬቢን፣ ማንሱሪ፣ አል-ቃንታራ እና ሀዳታ ባሉ አካባቢዎች ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች በሌሊት እና በረቡዕ ጠዋት የተካሄዱ ሲሆን በክልሉ ያለው ውጥረት እንዲጨምር አድርጓል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el gammoojjii Kibba Libaanoos irratti qilleensaan, boombii tankiidhaan fi dhukaatiin adda addaa haleellaa gaggeessaniiru. Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan akka Srebbine, Mansouri, al-Qantara fi Haddatha irratti xiyyeeffateera. Gochootni waraanaa kun halkan guutuu fi guyyaa Roobii ganamaa kan gaggeeffaman yoo ta'u, naannichatti waldhabdee uumame hammaachiseera.

title: US senator Van Hollen accuses Trump of profiting from war on Iran
english: US Senator Chris Van Hollen has publicly accused Donald Trump of using his presidency to personally benefit from the ongoing conflict in Iran. The senator claims that Trump has earned over a billion dollars since taking office while ordinary Americans struggle with rising costs. Van Hollen denounced these actions as clear corruption, alleging that the president is prioritizing his own financial portfolio over the well-being of the nation.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ሴናተር ክሪስ ቫን ሆለን ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን እየተካሄደ ካለው ጦርነት የግል ጥቅም እያገኙ ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። ሴናተሩ ትራምፕ ወደ ስልጣን ከተመለሱ በኋላ ከአንድ ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ አትርፈዋል ብለው ያምናሉ። ይህ ድርጊት ሙስና እንደሆነ እና ትራምፕ የአገሪቱን ችግር ለራሳቸው የገንዘብ ትርፍ እየተጠቀሙበት እንደሆነ በይፋ ተችተዋል።
oromo: Senator Ameerikaa Kiris Vaani Hoolen, Donald Traamp waraana Iraan keessatti adeemaa jiru fayyadamuun qabeenya dhuunfaa akka horachaa jiran himatanii jiru. Senatarichi, Traamp gara aangootti erga deebi'anii booda doolaara biliyoona tokko ol akka argatan ibsuun, kunis malaammaltummaa ifa ta'e akka ta'e dubbatu. Traamp rakkoo biyyaa fi dhukkubbii lammiilee fayyadamuun qabeenya isaanii dabachuu isaanii Senatarichi cimsanii balaaleeffataniiru.

title: At least 15 newborns killed in Pakistan hospital fire
english: A tragic fire at the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences in Islamabad has resulted in the deaths of at least 15 newborns. The blaze originated from an exploding air conditioner compressor within the nursery where 16 infants were being treated. Emergency crews have since extinguished the fire, and only one child managed to survive the incident.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ኢስላማባድ በሚገኝ የህክምና ተቋም ውስጥ በተከሰተ ድንገተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ 15 አዲስ የተወለዱ ሕፃናት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው የተከሰተው በህጻናት መንከባከቢያ ክፍል ውስጥ የነበረ የአየር ማቀዝቀዣ መጭመቂያ በፈነዳበት ወቅት ነው። በክፍሉ ውስጥ ከነበሩት 16 ህፃናት መካከል አንድ ልጅ ብቻ በሕይወት መትረፉ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Masaraa fayyaa Pistaanitti argamu kanneen Pakistan Instiituut of Medikaal Saayinsis jedhamutti ibiddi tasa ka’een daa’imman reefu dhalatan yoo xiqqaate 15 lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Iddoo daa’imman tursiisan sanatti ibiddi kun kan ka’e kompreesarii qabbaneessaa qilleensaa (air conditioner) tokkoo kan dhohee yoo ta’u, daa’imman achi turan 16 keessaa tokko qofatu lubbuun hafe.

title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopia's upcoming constitutional reforms and the shift toward demographic majoritarianism within the Prosperity Party are significantly altering the traditional influence of Amhara politics. Historically, Amhara political identity was deeply connected to the state's center, but it is now increasingly being marginalized as power shifts toward numerical representation based on population size. This transition marks a departure from the previous coalition model, forcing the Amhara political establishment to confront a new reality where their traditional dominance is no longer guaranteed.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ እየተካሄዱ ያሉት ሕገ-መንግሥታዊ ማሻሻያዎች እና ብልጽግና ፓርቲ የሚከተለው በቁጥር ላይ የተመሠረተ የውክልና አሠራር የአማራን የፖለቲካ ተፅእኖ እየለወጡት ይገኛል። በአንጻራዊ ሁኔታ አማራዎች የኢትዮጵያን የመንግሥት ማዕከል በቅርበት ሲቆጣጠሩ የቆዩ ቢሆንም፣ አሁን ያለው የፖለቲካ አሰላለፍ ወደ ቁጥር ተኮር ሥርዓት በመሸጋገሩ የፖለቲካ ተፅእኖአቸው እየተዳከመ መጥቷል። ይህ ለውጥ የቀድሞውን የጥምር ፓርቲ ሥርዓት በማስቀረት፣ የአማራ የፖለቲካ ኃይሎች በሕዝብ ብዛት ላይ በተመሠረተ አዲስ የፖለቲካ እውነታ ውስጥ መፈተናቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hojiin jijjiirama heera mootummaa Itoophiyaa fi imaammanni paartii Badhaadhinaa lakkoofsa ummataa irratti hundaa'e, dhiibbaa siyaasaa kan Amaaraa kanaan dura ture jijjiiraa jira. Akkuma kanaan dura, siyaasni Amaaraa giddugala mootummaa Itoophiyaa wajjin walitti hidhata cimaa kan qabu ture, garuu amma sirna lakkoofsa ummataa irratti hundaa'e kanaan gara alatti dhiibamaa jira. Jijjiiramni kun sirna kanaan dura ture kan diiguu fi siyaasni Amaaraa humna lakkoofsa ummataa irratti hundaa'e kana wajjin akka wal qabatu dirqisiisaa jira.

title: Dozens killed in rebel attacks on Sudan’s Kordofan, medical group says
english: A medical group reports that 27 people, including four children, were killed in attacks by the SPLM-N rebel group in Sudan’s South Kordofan province. The violence targeted the local Otoro tribe, forcing many residents to flee their homes and raising concerns about a potential ethnic conflict. Humanitarian organizations are now calling for international intervention to stop these attacks and protect civilians amid the broader Sudanese civil war.
amharic: የሱዳን የህክምና ባለሙያዎች አውታረ መረብ በሱዳን ደቡብ ኮርዶፋን ግዛት በታጣቂዎች በተፈፀመ ጥቃት አራት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ 27 ሰዎች መገደላቸውን አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱ በተለይ በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ የኦቶሮ ጎሳ አባላት ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ ብዙ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ምክንያት ሆኗል። የህክምና ቡድኑ ይህ ድርጊት በዘር ላይ ያነጣጠረ ግጭት እንዳይባባስ ስጋት የፈጠረ መሆኑን ገልጾ፣ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ በሲቪሎች ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃት ለማስቆም ጣልቃ እንዲገባ ጠይቋል።
oromo: Garee ogeeyyii fayyaa Sudaan akka gabaasetti, gareen finxaaleyyii SPLM-N jedhamu naannoo Kordofaan Kibbaatti namoota 27, kanneen keessaa ijoollee afur, ajjeesaniiru. Haleellaan kun sanyii Otoro irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, uummanni hedduunis qe'ee isaanii dhiisanii baqachuuf dirqamaniiru. Gareen fayyaa kun gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa sanyii hammaachuu danda'u waan sodaachisuuf, hawaasni idil-addunyaa miidhaa sivilii irra ga'u dhaabsisuuf tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gaafateera.

title: Instagram chief testifies at Meta trial, says few teens used safety feature
english: The head of Instagram, Adam Mosseri, testified in a major legal case against Meta, admitting that very few teenagers utilized the app's 'Take a Break' feature before it became mandatory. Meta is currently facing lawsuits from 29 U.S. states alleging that the company deliberately designed its platforms to be addictive and harmful to the mental health of young users. While the company denies these claims, it faces billions in potential damages for its practices involving data collection and child safety.
amharic: የኢንስታግራም ዋና ስራ አስኪያጅ አዳም ሞሴሪ በሜታ ኩባንያ ላይ በተመሰረተው ክስ ምስክርነታቸውን የሰጡ ሲሆን፣ አፕሊኬሽኑ 'እረፍት ይውሰዱ' የተሰኘውን የደህንነት መጠበቂያ አገልግሎት አስገዳጅ ከመሆኑ በፊት ጥቂት ታዳጊዎች ብቻ ይጠቀሙበት እንደነበር አምነዋል። ሜታ መድረኮቹን ሆን ብሎ ለታዳጊዎች ሱስ የሚያስይዙ እና ለጤና ጎጂ አድርጎ በመቅረጹ በ29 የአሜሪካ ግዛቶች ክስ ቀርቦበታል። ኩባንያው ክሱን ቢክድም፣ ህገ-ወጥ የመረጃ አሰባሰብ እና በታዳጊዎች ደህንነት ላይ ባደረሰው ጉዳት የቢሊዮን ዶላር ካሳ ሊጠየቅ ይችላል።
oromo: Hogganaan Instagram, Adam Mosseri, himata Meta irratti dhiyaate irratti dhugaa ba'aniiru. Akka isaan jedhanitti, 'Take a Break' ykn 'Boqannaa fudhadhu' kan jedhu meeshaan fayyadamtootaaf ofumaan akka hojjetu osoo hin godhin dura, ijoolleen muraasni qofa fayyadamaa turan. Meta irratti himanni kan dhiyaate, qindaa'ina fayyadamtoota isaa keessatti ijoollee fi dargaggoota adda durummaan akka itti hammadhan gochuu fi fayyaa isaanii irratti miidhaa geessisuu isaatiin walqabatee dha. Komii kana Meta kan haalu yoo ta'u, himannoon kun biyyoota 29 keessatti dhiyaatee fi kaffaltii miiliyoonaan lakkaa'amu gaafachuu isaatiin mata-duree guddina argate dha.

title: Who were the Syrian Democratic Forces and why dissolve?
english: The Syrian Democratic Forces, a coalition that played a major role in the battle against ISIL, have announced they are disbanding. This decision follows an agreement with the Syrian interim government to fold various militia groups into the national army. The move aims to consolidate military power under the country's official armed forces.
amharic: በአይኤስአይኤል ላይ በተደረገው ውጊያ ግንባር ቀደም ሚና የነበራቸው የሶሪያ ዴሞክራቲክ ኃይሎች መፍረሳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ከተለያዩ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ጋር በመስማማት እነርሱን በሀገሪቱ ኦፊሴላዊ የጦር ኃይል ውስጥ ለማካተት ነው። ይህ እርምጃ ወታደራዊ ኃይልን በሀገሪቱ መደበኛ የጦር ሠራዊት ስር ለማሰባሰብ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Dimookiraatawaa Siiriyaa, kan ISIL irratti lolarratti hirmaachaa turan, akka diigaman beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan fudhatame mootummaa yeroo Siiriyaa waliin walii galtee uumuun gareewwan hidhattootaa gara raayyaa ittisa biyyattiitti makufi. Tarkaanfiin kun humnoota waraanaa biyyattii jala tokko gochuufi.

title: Bangladesh could join Mecca pact, official suggests
english: Bangladesh is considering joining a new security pact involving Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan. This agreement functions similarly to NATO by treating an attack on one member as an assault on the entire group. Officials in Dhaka have responded positively to the invitation, suggesting that the nation is open to participating in this collective military alliance.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በቱርክ፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል የተፈረመውን አዲስ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት የመቀላቀል እድልን እያጤነች ነው። ይህ ስምምነት በአንዱ አባል ሀገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደደረሰ የሚቆጠርበት የኔቶ አይነት ወታደራዊ መርህ አለው። የባንግላዲሽ መንግስት ለዚህ ጥሪ አዎንታዊ ምላሽ የሰጠ ሲሆን በስምምነቱ ውስጥ የመሳተፍ ፍላጎት እንዳለው አመላክቷል።
oromo: Bangladeshiin waliigaltee nageenyaa haaraa kan Turkey, Saudi Arabia fi Pakistan gidduutti mallatteeffame waliin makamuuf yaadaa jirti. Waliigalteen kun akka NATO, biyyoota miseensa ta'an keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, kanneen biroos akka haleelamanii fudhatamu ibsa. Mootummaan Bangladesh afeerrii kanaaf deebii gaarii kennee fi waliigaltee kana keessatti hirmaachuuf fedhii akka qabu ibseera.

title: Houthi leader underlines support for Palestinians, slams Saudi 'tyranny'
english: Houthi leader Abdel-Malik al-Houthi has reaffirmed his group's commitment to supporting Palestinian fighters in their conflict against Israel. He also criticized Saudi Arabia, accusing the country of oppressing the Yemeni people through a blockade and military aggression. Consequently, he called for stronger actions to oppose Saudi policies, which he claims are supported by the United States.
amharic: የሁቲው መሪ አብዱል-ማሊክ አል-ሁቲ ለፍልስጤም ታጋዮች ያላቸውን ድጋፍ እንደገና አረጋግጠዋል። በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይም በየመን ህዝብ ላይ ግፍ እና ጭቆና ፈፅመዋል በማለት ጠንካራ ወቀሳ ሰንዝረዋል። የሳውዲ አረቢያ ፖሊሲዎች በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የሚከናወኑ ናቸው ያሉት መሪው፣ እነዚህን ድርጊቶች ለመቃወም አዳዲስ እርምጃዎችን እንደሚወስዱ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan garee Huutii Abdel-Maalik al-Huutii, loltoota Falasxiinif deeggarsa qaban kan irra deebi'anii mirkaneessan ta'uu ibsame. Sudaan Arabaa ilaalchisees, ummata Yamanirratti cunqursaa fi gochaa sirrii hin taane raawwachuu isaaniitiin balaaleffataniiru. Gochi kunis deeggarsa Ameerikaatiin kan raawwatamu ta'uu eeruun, siyaasa Sa'udii kana mormuuf tarkaanfiin haaraan akka fudhatamu waamicha dhiyeessaniiru.

title: Israeli soldiers block Knesset member from besieged Palestinian home
english: Israeli military personnel prevented Knesset member Ofer Cassif from visiting a Palestinian family in the West Bank village of Qusra. The family has been under a blockade by Israeli settlers for over two weeks. Despite the initial obstruction by the soldiers, the politician eventually succeeded in reaching the residents to offer his solidarity.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች የፓርላማ አባል የሆኑትን ኦፈር ካሲፍ በዌስት ባንክ ቁስራ መንደር የሚኖሩ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰብን እንዳይጎበኙ ከልክለዋቸዋል። ቤተሰቡ ለ17 ቀናት በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ተከበው እንደነበር ተገልጿል። በመጨረሻም የፓርላማ አባሉ ወታደሮቹ ቢከለክሏቸውም ወደ ቤተሰቡ በመድረስ ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el miseensa Mana Maree (Knesset) Ofer Cassif jedhaman, maatii Palastaayinii magaalaa Qusraa, kan Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessa jiraatan akka hin daawwanne dhowwate. Maatiin kun guyyoota 17f qe'ee isaanii keessatti qarqara lixaa kan qubatanii jiran irraa baqachuu hin dandeenye ture. Hanqina waraanni uumeen ala, miseensi kun boodarra maatii sana bira gahuun gadda isaanii qooddachuuf danda'eera.

title: Mamdani opposes Hindu nationalist event in New York
english: New York official Zohran Mamdani has publicly criticized a planned Hindu nationalist event at Madison Square Garden. He expressed concern that the group behind the gathering promotes an exclusionary agenda and maintains ties to India’s ruling political party. Mamdani's opposition highlights tensions regarding the group's ideological influence within the city.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ባለስልጣን ዞህራን ማምዳኒ በሜዲሰን ስኩዌር ጋርደን ሊካሄድ የታቀደውን የሂንዱ ብሄርተኛ ዝግጅት በይፋ ተቃውመዋል። ዝግጅቱን የሚያዘጋጀው ቡድን አድልኦ የተሞላበት አካሄድ እንዳለው እና ከህንድ ገዥ ፓርቲ ጋር ጥብቅ ግንኙነት እንዳለው ገልጸዋል። የማምዳኒ ተቃውሞ ቡድኑ በከተማዋ ሊኖረው ስለሚችለው የርዕዮተ ዓለም ተጽዕኖ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni magaalaa Niyoork Zohran Mamdani, sagantaa biyyaaleessa Hindu kan madison Square Garden keessatti qophaa'uuf karoorfame mormaniiru. Gareen saganticha qopheessu kun ilaalcha namaa gargar qoodu qabaachuu fi paartii biyya Indiyaa bulchaa jiru waliin hidhata cimaa akka qaban ibsaniiru. Mormiin Mamdani, dhiibbaa ideolojiin garee kanaa magaalaatti qabaachuu danda'u irratti yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Water crisis makes life in Sudan’s El Obeid refugee camps even worse
english: Families living in refugee camps in El Obeid, Sudan, are facing a severe humanitarian struggle due to a critical lack of water. This shortage is largely caused by the Rapid Support Forces, who are intentionally attacking the city's essential water infrastructure. As a result, the displaced population is enduring increasingly difficult and dangerous living conditions.
amharic: በሱዳን ኤል ኦቤይድ የስደተኞች መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች የሚኖሩ ቤተሰቦች በከባድ የውሃ እጥረት እየተሰቃዩ ይገኛል። ይህ ችግር የተፈጠረው የራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርሶች የከተማዋን ዋና ዋና የውሃ ምንጮች በማጥቃታቸው ነው። በጦርነቱ የተፈናቀሉ ሰዎች በአስቸጋሪ እና በከፋ የኑሮ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንዲያልፉ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Maatiin buufata baqattootaa El Obeid, Sudaan keessa jiraatan hanqina bishaanii cimaan miidhamaniiru. Hanqinni kun kan uumame waraana Rapid Support Forces tiin maddoota bishaan magaala sanatti xiyyeeffatanii haleelaa waan jiraniifi. Bu’aa kanaanis, namoonni sababa waraanaan buqqa’an haala jireenyaa baay’ee ulfaataa fi sodaachisaa ta’e keessa darbanii jiru.

title: Israel expels Dutch representatives from Gaza coordination center
english: Israel has ordered Dutch representatives to leave a Gaza coordination facility and exit the country within a week. This action was taken after the Netherlands moved to prohibit imports coming from Israeli settlements in occupied territories. Israeli officials described this move as a retaliatory measure against what they consider to be hostile policies from the Dutch government.
amharic: ኔዘርላንድስ ከተያዙት የፍልስጤም ግዛቶች የሚመጡ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ምርቶችን እንደምትከለክል ካስታወቀች በኋላ፣ እስራኤል የደች ተወካዮችን ከጋዛ ማስተባበሪያ ማዕከል አባረረች። እስራኤል ተወካዮቹ በአንድ ሳምንት ውስጥ አገሪቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አዘዛለች። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ይህ ውሳኔ የደች መንግስት በእስራኤል ላይ እየወሰዳቸው ባሉ ተከታታይ እርምጃዎች የተወሰደ የበቀል እርምጃ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan ykn mootummaan Israa'el bakka bu'oota biyya Neezerlaand kanneen Gaza keessatti qindoomina irratti hojjetan biyyattii akka gadhiisan ajajtee jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame Neezerlaandi oomishoota buufataalee Israa'el kanneen lafa qabame keessa jiran irraa dhufan akka hin seennesne murteessuun ishee hordofee dha. Mootummaan Israa'el tarkaanfii kana kan fudhate, gochaalee mootummaan Neezerlaand Israa'el irratti qabate jedhanii kan mormaniif deebii kennuuf akka ta'e ibseera.

title: Malaysia’s Anwar puts non-aligned stance in focus with remarks on Taiwan
english: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim sparked debate after stating that Taiwan is part of China, leading to criticism from the Taiwanese government. While China praised his remarks, Anwar later clarified that he supports a peaceful resolution to the cross-strait conflict. Amid these tensions, the Prime Minister is also seeking to strengthen Malaysia's military defenses near the Philippines, highlighting his effort to balance the country's non-aligned stance.
amharic: የማሌዥያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዋር ኢብራሂም ታይዋን የቻይና አካል ናት በሚል የሰጡት አስተያየት አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። ይህ ንግግር በቻይና ዘንድ ምስጋና ቢቸረውም፣ ታይዋን ግን አቋሙን በመተቸት ስጋቷን ገልጻለች። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ በኋላ ላይ ግጭቶች በሰላማዊ መንገድ እንዲፈቱ እንደሚፈልጉ አስታውቀዋል። በተመሳሳይ ወቅት፣ ከፊሊፒንስ አቅራቢያ የሚገኘውን ወታደራዊ አቅማቸውን ለማጠናከር እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ማሌዥያ በቻይና እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያላትን ገለልተኛ አቋም ለመጠበቅ የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Maleeziyaa Anwaar Ibraahim, Taayilaandiin kutaa Chaayinaati jechuun isaanii mormii fi haasaa guddaa uumee jira. Chaayinaan ibsa isaanii kana yoo galateeffattu, mootummaan Taayilaandi garuu yaada isaanii kana balaaleffatee jira. Anwaar yeroo booda rakkoon kun nagaan akka furamu fedha qaban ibsuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Kana malees, Maleeziyaan biyyoota gurguddoo lamaan gidduutti qabxii giddu-galeessummaa qabachuu ishee ibsuuf, daangaa biyyattii irra jiru cimsuuf sochii gochaa jiru.

title: Is Sudan’s battlefield shaping the terms of its next political phase?
english: Sudan’s ongoing civil war is experiencing a potential turning point as the national army secures key supply routes in North Kordofan. The paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are struggling with internal unity, evidenced by a rising number of soldiers and commanders defecting to the military. Meanwhile, General al-Burhan is attempting to leverage these battlefield successes to guide the nation's future political landscape.
amharic: የሱዳን የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት የሀገሪቱ ጦር በሰሜን ኮርዶፋን ስልታዊ የሆኑ የትራንስፖርት መስመሮችን በመቆጣጠሩ አዲስ ምዕራፍ ላይ የደረሰ ይመስላል። የፈጥኖ ደራሽ ኃይሉ (RSF) ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ወታደሮች እና አዛዦች ወደ መንግስት ጦር እየተቀላቀሉ በመሆኑ የውስጥ መከፋፈል ገጥሞታል። በዚህ ሁኔታ ውስጥ የሀገሪቱ የጦር መሪ ጄኔራል አል-ቡርሃን በጦር ሜዳ የተገኙ ውጤቶችን በመጠቀም የፖለቲካ ሂደቱን ለመምራት እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraanni biyya Sudaan keessatti adeemsifamaa jiru jijjiirama barbaachisaa tokko keessa jira; kunis kan ta'e humnoonni waraana mootummaa daandiiwwan dhiyeessii ijoo ta'an naannoo Kordofaan Kaabaatti too'annaa isaanii jala galchuun isaaniiti. Humnoonni Rapid Support Forces (RSF) jedhaman lollatoonniifi ajajoonni isaanii hedduun gara waraana mootummaatti dabalamuu isaaniitiin rakkoo tokkummaa keessoo waliin qabsoo irra jiru. Gammachuu waraana kanaa fayyadamuun, Jeneraal Al-Burhaan adeemsa siyaasaa gara fuulduraa irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf yaalaa jiru.

title: Human rights situation in Myanmar ‘plummets to new low’, UN says
english: The United Nations reports that the human rights situation in Myanmar has reached a critical low since the 2021 military coup. Ongoing violence, including airstrikes and forced labor, has resulted in thousands of civilian deaths, millions of displaced people, and widespread malnutrition. Additionally, the Rohingya minority continues to face systematic abuse and violence from both the military and local ethnic armed groups.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በምያንማር ያለው የሰብአዊ መብት ሁኔታ ከ2021 ወታደራዊ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ወዲህ እጅግ አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን አስታውቋል። በአየር ጥቃትና በግዴታ ስራ ምክንያት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች መገደላቸውን፣ በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ መፈናቀላቸውን እና የምግብ እጥረት መስፋፋቱን ሪፖርቱ ያሳያል። በተጨማሪም የሮሂንጋ አናሳ ብሄረሰብ በወታደራዊው መንግስት እና በተለያዩ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች በኩል ስልታዊ ጥቃትና በደል እየደረሰባቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, haalli mirga namoomaa biyya Miyaanmaar keessatti kanneen bara 2021 erga mootummaan waraanaa aangoo qabatee as hammaatee jira. Waraana, miidhaa qaamaa fi buqqaatiin namoota kumaatamaatti lakkaa’aman ajjeesee, miiliyoonatti kan lakkaa’aman ammoo qe’ee irraa buqqisee akkasumas hanqina nyaataa cimaa fidee jira. Akkaataa kanaan, sanyiin xiqqaan Roohingiyaa lachuu mootummaa waraanaa fi garee hidhattootaa irraa miidhaa fi dararaa hamaa keessa jiru.

title: Israeli troops advance into Syrian village, attack southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces have moved into the village of Jumla within Syria's Daraa region. Simultaneously, the Israeli air force conducted a bombing operation against Kafr Rummana in southern Lebanon. These actions represent a significant escalation of ongoing regional military activity.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በሶሪያ ዳራ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኘው የጁምላ መንደር መግባታቸው ተዘግቧል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ፣ የእስራኤል አየር ኃይል በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው ካፍር ሩማና ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የሚያጠናክሩ ናቸው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Jumlaa kan naannoo Daaraa Sooriyaa keessatti argamu seenaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, xiyyaaronni waraana Israa'el ganda Kafr Ruumaanaa kan kibba Liibaanoos keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Gochootni kun sochii waraana naannichaa kan yeroodhaa gara yerootti jabaataa deemu kan agarsiisanidha.

title: Watch: Analyst says US lacks leverage to force global isolation of Iran
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has introduced a new policy called 'Operation Economic Outcast,' demanding that nations sever all economic ties with Iran. The initiative threatens sanctions against any country that refuses to comply with these US demands. Analysts are questioning whether this strategy will be effective or if it signals a lack of viable diplomatic options for the current administration.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት 'ኦፕሬሽን ኢኮኖሚክ አውትካስት' የተሰኘ አዲስ ፖሊሲ ይፋ አድርገዋል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት፣ አገራት ከኢራን ጋር ያላቸውን የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጡ የሚጠይቅ ሲሆን፣ ይህንን ለማያደርጉ አገራት ማዕቀብ እንደሚጣልባቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል። ተንታኞች ይህ ስልት ውጤታማ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ወይም የአሜሪካ አስተዳደር አማራጭ መፍትሄዎች እንደሌሉት በመጠራጠር ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Ameerikaa Iskoottii Besent, 'Operation Economic Outcast' kan jedhamu duula haaraa biyyoonni Iran waliin hariiroo diinagdee hunda akka kutatan dirqisiisuu jalqabaniiru. Ameerikaan biyyoonni ajaja kana hin fudhanne irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa (sanctions) fudhachuu akka dandeessu akeekkachiisteetti. Hayyoonni hedduun duulli kun bu'aa qabaachuu isaa ykn mootummaan kun furmaata biraa dhabuun isaa shakkiin keessa galaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Iran says Hormuz remains closed despite Oman route deal
english: Iranian officials have declared that the Strait of Hormuz remains closed, rejecting claims that a transit agreement with Oman has resolved the issue. While President Trump stated that international waters in the strait have been cleared of mines, Iran insists that the route will stay blocked until the United States fulfills its previous commitments. The U.S. has warned that any future attempts by Iran to deploy mines in the area will be met with immediate military action.
amharic: የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ከኦማን ጋር በተደረገው ስምምነት መሰረት የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ክፍት እንደሆነ የሚነገረውን መረጃ አስተባብለዋል። የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ፈንጂዎች መጸዳታቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ ኢራን አሜሪካ የተገባላትን ቃል እስካልጠበቀች ድረስ የባህር መስመሩ ዝግ እንደሚሆን አስታውቃለች። አሜሪካ በበኩሏ ኢራን እንደገና ፈንጂዎችን ብትጥል ተመጣጣኝ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran akka jedhanitti, walii galtee Omaan waliin godhamee jiruun ala balballi galaana Hormuz kan cufame dha. Preezidaant Traampii fiixee bishaanota idil-addunyaa keessatti minoonni hundi qulqulleeffamaniiru jedhanii himanis, Iran hanga Ameerikaan waadaa ishee eegutti karaichi cufaa akka ta'e dubbatti. Ameerikaan gama isheetiin, Iran yoo gara fuulduraatti minoota kaahuu yaalte tarkaanfiin waraanaa irratti fudhatamuuf akka jiru akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Yemeni forces claim killing of eight Houthi fighters
english: Yemeni government forces successfully defended their positions after a Houthi attack in the southwestern province of Taiz. During the intense battle, which involved significant gunfire, at least eight Houthi fighters were killed. The military confirmed that the fighting took place in the al-Safa region.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በታኢዝ ግዛት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተሰነዘረባቸውን ጥቃት መክተው መመለሳቸውን አስታወቁ። በአል-ሳፋ አካባቢ በተካሄደው ከባድ የተኩስ ልውውጥ ቢያንስ ስምንት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸው ተገልጿል። የሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ ዕዝ ግጭቱ በከባድ መሳሪያ የታጀበ እንደነበር አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman naannoo Ta'izitti haleellaa garee Huutii irratti gaggeeffame fashaleessuu isaanii beeksisan. Walitti bu'iinsa cimaa naannoo Al-Safaatti gaggeeffame kanaan, garee Huutii keessaa namoonni saddeet ol ta'an ajjeefamaniiru. Ajajni waraanaa Yaman akka ibsetti, walitti bu'iinsi kun wal-jijjiirraa rasaasaa cimaa kan of keessatti qabate ture.

title: Death toll from Israeli attack in north Gaza rises to four
english: At least four individuals have died following an Israeli military strike near the Abu Hussein school in the Jabalia refugee camp, located in northern Gaza. Local reports indicate that the attack targeted this specific area within the camp. Authorities have confirmed the fatalities as the situation remains critical.
amharic: በሰሜን ጋዛ በሚገኘው የጃባሊያ ስደተኞች ካምፕ አቅራቢያ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። ጥቃቱ ያነጣጠረው በአቡ ሁሴን ትምህርት ቤት አካባቢ መሆኑ ታውቋል። የአካባቢው መገናኛ ብዙሃን እንደገለጹት የሟቾች ቁጥር እስካሁን አራት መድረሱ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Kaaba Gaazaatti kan argamu buufata baqattootaa Jaabaaliyaa keessatti, weerara Israa'el iddoo mana barnootaa Abuu Huseen cinaatti gaggeessiteen lubbuun namoota afur darbeera. Gabaasni miidiyaa naannichaa akka ibsutti, haleellaan kun buufata sanatti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, namootni kunneen bakka sanaatti du'uun mirkanaa'eera.

title: UK backs US efforts for diplomatic solution on Iran
english: The British government has officially backed the United States' strategy to resolve tensions with Iran through diplomacy. Following the announcement of new American sanctions, UK officials expressed their support for increased pressure on the Iranian government. Additionally, the UK has urged Tehran to stop its disruptive actions throughout the region, specifically within the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት ከአሜሪካ ጋር በመተባበር ከኢራን ጋር ያለውን ውጥረት በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት እንደሚደግፍ አስታውቋል። አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ አዲስ ማዕቀብ መጣሏን ተከትሎ፣ የብሪታንያ ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ጫና እንደሚደግፉ ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም ብሪታንያ፣ ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ እና በአካባቢው የምታደርገውን አለመረጋጋት እንድታቆም አሳስባለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritish, yaalii Ameerikaan dhimma Iraan karaa dippilomaasii furuuf taasisaa jirtu akka deggeru beeksiseera. Ameerikaan Iraan irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa haaraa fudhachuu ishee hordofee, qondaalonni Biritish dhiibbaa kana akka deggeran ibsaniiru. Kana malees, Biritish mootummaan Iraan naannichaa fi handhuura Hormuz keessatti gochaa tasgabbii dhabsiisuu raawwachuu ishee akka dhaabu gaafatteetti.

title: Trump says Saudi Arabia must recognise Israel to move forward with nuclear pact
english: President Donald Trump has informed Congress that a civil nuclear energy deal with Saudi Arabia is dependent on the kingdom recognizing Israel. The U.S. administration insists that Riyadh must join the Abraham Accords for the agreement to proceed. This policy highlights a continued push to link regional diplomatic normalization with strategic cooperation.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከሳውዲ አረቢያ ጋር የሚደረገው የኒውክሌር ኃይል ስምምነት እንዲሳካ ሳውዲ እስራኤልን መለየት እንዳለባት ለኮንግረሱ አስታውቀዋል። የአሜሪካ አስተዳደር ስምምነቱ ወደፊት እንዲቀጥል የሳውዲ መንግስት በአብርሃም ስምምነት ውስጥ መካተት እንዳለበት አጽንዖት ሰጥቷል። ይህ እርምጃ ቀጣናዊ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶችን እና ስልታዊ ትብብርን ለማቀናጀት የሚደረግ ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp waliigaltee anniisaa niwuukileeraa Sa'udii Arabiyaa wajjin godhamu duraa duuba akka qabuuf, Sa'udiin Israa'el beekamtii kennuu qabdi jechuun koongiresitti himaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa waliigaltee kana raawwachuuf Sa'udiin 'Abraham Accords' keessatti hirmaachuu akka qabdu jabeessitanii dubbataniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo dippilomaasii naannichaa fi walta'iinsa tarsiimawaa walqabsiisuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Brazil fines TikTok $30m for child data privacy violations
english: Brazil has fined TikTok's parent company, ByteDance, nearly $30 million for mishandling the personal information of millions of young users. Regulators found that the platform's age-verification systems were flawed, allowing children to access the app without proper safeguards. The company has been ordered to delete the illegally collected data and develop a better plan to protect minors.

title: Why can’t America agree on what time it is?
english: The United States is currently debating whether to stop the practice of changing clocks twice a year. While the House of Representatives has supported making daylight saving time permanent, the Senate has yet to reach an agreement on the matter. Historical attempts to implement this change have failed in the past, leading to ongoing uncertainty about the country's timekeeping future.

title: Israeli army conducts major blast in south Lebanon town
english: The Israeli military executed a significant explosion in the southern Lebanese town of Khiam. This action follows other recent Israeli attacks that occurred in the towns of al-Mansouri and Sarbin. Lebanese news sources confirmed that these military activities are part of an ongoing escalation in the region.

Tarkaanfiin kun kan hordofe miidhaa kanaan dura magaalaawwan al-Mansouri fi Sarbin keessatti raawwatamaniiti. Maddoonni oduu Liibaanoos akka gabaasanitti, gochi kun naannichatti waraanni daran hammaachaa akka jiru argisiisa.

title: Rubio says US not expected to launch new strikes on Iran
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has informed allied nations that the US is currently not planning further military attacks against Iran. Instead, the government intends to prioritize non-military strategies to exert pressure on the country. This shift follows the recent introduction of significant new economic sanctions against Tehran.

oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarko Rubiyoon, Ameerikaan yeroo ammaa kana weerara waraanaa dabalataa Iran irratti raawwachuuf karooras ta'e yaada akka hin qabne biyyoota michoota ishee ta'anitti himeera. Kanaa mannaa, Ameerikaan Iran irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf mala waraanaa hin taane fayyadamuuf xiyyeeffannaa kenniti. Murtoon kun kan dhufu erga erga tarkaanfiin diinagdee cimaan irratti fudhatamee booda.

title: US judge blocks Ohio law requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote
english: A federal judge in Ohio has temporarily stopped a new state law that demanded proof of citizenship for voter registration during driver's license applications. The judge ruled that the law likely violates the National Voter Registration Act by requesting unnecessary documentation and creating extra barriers for eligible voters. This decision prevents the state from requiring such proof, asserting that a signed declaration of citizenship is sufficient for registration.

Murtee kanaanis, lammiileen mirga isaanii akka argataniif ragaa lammummaa dhiyeessuu mannaa, ofiin mallatteessanii mirkaneessuun isaanii akka gahu ibsameera.

title: Who was the ‘Queen of Country’ Dolly Parton?
english: Country music icon Dolly Parton has passed away in Nashville, Tennessee, at the age of 80. Her family and representatives confirmed the news of her death. Parton was widely celebrated as the legendary Queen of Country for her immense contributions to the music industry.

title: Seven killed in Gaza as Israeli strike ‘destroys’ aid supply warehouse
english: Israeli military strikes across Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least seven Palestinians despite an existing ceasefire. Among the attacks, a critical warehouse storing nutritional aid for women and children was destroyed, ruining essential supplies. Health officials have warned that these ongoing strikes are pushing the region toward a total collapse of basic life-sustaining services.

title: Iran's Ghalibaf tells Iraqi official 'new regional order' being created
english: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf recently informed Iraq's chief justice that a new regional order is emerging in the Middle East. He praised the upcoming withdrawal of American forces from Iraq as a significant achievement for the country. Ghalibaf also claimed that Iran has successfully resisted U.S. political and military influence, predicting that American efforts to pressure the region will ultimately fail.

Iran dhiibbaa Ameerikaa waraanaanis ta'e siyaasaan akka moote fi karoora Ameerikaa kan biroo akka fashalsiistu ibsaniiru.

title: Israel destroys Gaza warehouse supplies for malnourished children and pregnant women
english: An Israeli airstrike in central Gaza has destroyed a warehouse containing vital nutritional supplies intended for malnourished children and expectant mothers. The facility, operated by a local charity, suffered extensive structural damage that ruined all stored goods. This loss significantly hampers humanitarian efforts to provide essential care to vulnerable groups facing severe food shortages in the region.
